title.en: Secure and govern Power BI items
title.zh: 保护和治理 Power BI 项目

takeaways.en: Four workspace roles: Admin, Member, Contributor, Viewer — each includes the rights of the ones below it.
takeaways.zh: 四种工作区角色：管理员、成员、参与者、查看者——每种都包含下级角色的权限。

takeaways.en: Contributors can create and edit content but cannot share or manage access; Viewers can only view.
takeaways.zh: 参与者可以建立和编辑内容，但不能分享或管理访问权限；查看者只能查看。

takeaways.en: Row-level security applies only to Viewers (and people given read access); Admin, Member and Contributor see all data.
takeaways.zh: 行级别安全性只对查看者（以及被授予读取权限的人）生效；管理员、成员和参与者能看到所有数据。

rows.en: Create, edit, delete content; publish reports
rows.zh: 建立、编辑、删除内容；发布报表
计划刷新、配置语义模型

rows.en: Share items, add others with lower roles
rows.zh: 分享项目，添加较低角色的成员

rows.en: Add/remove Admins, delete workspace, change settings
rows.zh: 添加/移除管理员、删除工作区、更改设置

html.en: Assign roles in the workspace's Manage access to users, Microsoft Entra security groups, Microsoft 365 groups or distribution lists. Using groups makes access easier to manage as people join and leave.
html.zh: 在工作区的管理访问权限中，把角色分配给用户、Microsoft Entra 安全组、Microsoft 365 组或通讯组列表。使用组可以让人员加入和离开时更容易管理访问权限。

html.en: The classic trap: RLS is tested by a colleague who is a Member of the workspace and sees everything. RLS does not apply to Admin, Member or Contributor. Give report consumers the Viewer role or an app.
html.zh: 经典陷阱：由工作区「成员」同事测试 RLS，结果看到全部数据。RLS 对管理员、成员和参与者无效。应给报表读者「查看者」角色或通过应用分发。

q.en: Analysts must publish and edit reports in a workspace but must not be able to share content or add people. Which role?
q.zh: 分析师需要在工作区中发布和编辑报表，但不能分享内容或添加人员。用哪个角色？

why.en: Members can share and add people.
why.zh: 成员可以分享和添加人员。

q.en: RLS restricts sales reps to their region, but a sales rep who is a workspace Member sees all regions. Why?
q.zh: RLS 限制销售代表只能看自己的区域，但一位身为工作区「成员」的销售代表却看到所有区域。为什么？

html.en: The semantic model is not certified
RLS does not apply to Admin, Member or Contributor roles
html.zh: RLS 对管理员、成员和参与者角色无效

why.en: Right: give that person the Viewer role or app access.
why.zh: 对：应给此人「查看者」角色或应用访问权限。

heading.zh: 项目级与语义模型访问

takeaways.en: You can share a single report or dashboard without giving workspace access, choosing whether recipients can reshare or build.
takeaways.zh: 可以只分享单一报表或仪表板而不提供工作区访问权限，并选择收件人能否重新分享或生成内容。

takeaways.en: Semantic model permissions: Read, Build, Reshare and Write.
takeaways.zh: 语义模型权限：读取、生成、重新分享和写入。

takeaways.en: Build permission lets people create their own reports, use Analyze in Excel, and connect live to the model.
takeaways.zh: 生成（Build）权限让人可以制作自己的报表、使用「在 Excel 中分析」，并实时连接到模型。

html.en: On a report or dashboard select Share. Choose who the link works for (people in your organisation, people with existing access, or specific people) and tick Allow recipients to share and Allow recipients to build content with the data associated with this report as needed. Manage permissions shows and removes direct access and links.
html.zh: 在报表或仪表板上选择分享。选择链接对谁有效（组织中的人员、已有访问权限的人员或特定人员），并按需要勾选允许收件人分享和允许收件人使用与此报表关联的数据生成内容。管理权限可查看和移除直接访问权限及链接。

rows.en: View reports that use the model
rows.zh: 查看使用该模型的报表

rows.en: Create new reports, Analyze in Excel, live connect from Desktop, query with DAX
rows.zh: 制作新报表、在 Excel 中分析、从 Desktop 实时连接、用 DAX 查询

rows.en: Edit the model (comes with Admin, Member, Contributor roles)
rows.zh: 编辑模型（管理员、成员、参与者角色自带）

html.en: Manage these on the semantic model: More options → Manage permissions. Granting Build through an app is also possible ("allow everyone with app access to build content").
html.zh: 在语义模型上管理：更多选项 → 管理权限。也可以通过应用授予生成权限（「允许所有有应用访问权限的人生成内容」）。

q.en: A business analyst should create new reports from the certified Sales model but not edit the model. Which permission?
q.zh: 某业务分析师应该能基于认证的 Sales 模型制作新报表，但不能编辑模型。用哪个权限？

why.en: Viewer alone gives Read, not Build.
why.zh: 仅「查看者」角色只给读取权限，没有生成权限。
写入权限允许修改模型。

takeaways.en: RLS roles are defined in Desktop with DAX filters on tables; filters flow to related tables through relationships.
takeaways.zh: RLS 角色在 Desktop 中定义，用 DAX 筛选表；筛选会通过关系传递到相关的表。

takeaways.en: Static RLS hard-codes values (Region = "West"); dynamic RLS uses USERPRINCIPALNAME() to filter by the signed-in user.
takeaways.zh: 静态 RLS 把值写死（Region = "West"）；动态 RLS 用 USERPRINCIPALNAME() 按登录用户筛选。

takeaways.en: Test with View as in Desktop or Test as role in the service; assign users or groups to roles in the service.
takeaways.zh: 在 Desktop 中用「以角色身份查看」测试，或在服务中用「以角色身份测试」；在服务中把用户或组分配给角色。

html.en: Row-level security (RLS) restricts which rows a user can see in the same report. One report and one model serve every region, but each manager sees only their own.
html.zh: 行级别安全性（RLS）限制用户在同一份报表中能看到哪些行。一份报表和一个模型服务所有区域，但每位经理只看到自己的区域。

items.en: Desktop: Modeling → Manage roles → New. Name the role, select a table and enter a DAX filter (or use the default rules editor).
items.zh: Desktop：建模 → 管理角色 → 新建。为角色命名，选择表并输入 DAX 筛选（或使用默认的规则编辑器）。

items.en: Modeling → View as to test the role (and "Other user" to test dynamic rules).
items.zh: 建模 → 以角色身份查看来测试角色（用「其他用户」测试动态规则）。

items.en: Publish. In the service open the semantic model → Security, and add users or security groups to each role.
items.zh: 发布。在服务中打开语义模型 → 安全性，为每个角色添加用户或安全组。

items.en: Use Test as role in the service to check.
items.zh: 在服务中使用以角色身份测试来检查。

blocks.text:
-- Static role "West" on the Store table
[Region] = "West"

-- Dynamic role on the Employee table: each user sees rows for their own email
[Email] = USERPRINCIPALNAME ()

-- Dynamic, through a mapping table UserRegion(Email, Region) related to Store
-- role filter on UserRegion:
[Email] = USERPRINCIPALNAME ()

rows.en: Based on who signs in: USERPRINCIPALNAME()

rows.zh: 通常所有人共用一个角色

rows.en: Edit the mapping table data only
rows.zh: 只需修改对照表的数据

html.en: If the filter is on a dimension that must restrict another dimension through a fact table, tick Apply security filter in both directions on that relationship. A user in several roles sees the union of their roles' rows.
html.zh: 如果筛选位于一个维度表上，又必须通过事实表去限制另一个维度表，就要在该关系上勾选在两个方向上应用安全筛选器。同时属于多个角色的用户，会看到这些角色可见行的并集。

html.en: Assign Microsoft Entra security groups (or mail-enabled security groups) to roles instead of individuals. When someone moves to another team, IT changes the group and the report follows automatically.
html.zh: 把 Microsoft Entra 安全组（或启用邮件的安全组）分配给角色，而不是分配给个人。当有人调到别的团队时，IT 只要修改组，报表就会自动跟上。

q.en: Each of 300 salespeople must see only their own customers, and new hires join every month. Which RLS design is easiest to maintain?
q.zh: 300 名销售人员每人只能看到自己的客户，而且每月都有新员工加入。哪种 RLS 设计最容易维护？

html.zh: 每位销售人员一份报表

html.en: One dynamic role filtering on [Email] = USERPRINCIPALNAME()
html.zh: 一个动态角色，筛选 [Email] = USERPRINCIPALNAME()

why.en: Right: new people only need a row in the data and membership of the role (or a group).
why.zh: 对：新员工只需要在数据中加一行，并加入该角色（或某个组）。

html.zh: 每位销售人员一个静态角色

why.en: 300 roles that must change every month.

q.en: Where do you add users to an RLS role after publishing?
q.zh: 发布后在哪里把用户添加到 RLS 角色？

html.zh: 工作区 → 管理访问权限

why.en: That sets workspace roles, not RLS roles.
why.zh: 那里设定的是工作区角色，不是 RLS 角色。

html.zh: Desktop 中的 建模 → 管理角色

why.en: Roles and their filters are defined there; membership is set in the service.
why.zh: 那里定义角色和筛选；成员资格在服务中设定。

html.en: Semantic model → Security in the Power BI service
html.zh: Power BI 服务中的 语义模型 → 安全性

takeaways.en: Sensitivity labels from Microsoft Purview Information Protection classify content as Public, General, Confidential and so on.
takeaways.zh: 来自 Microsoft Purview 信息保护的敏感度标签，会把内容分类为公开、一般、机密等。

takeaways.en: Labels can be applied in Desktop or the service and are inherited by downstream items (semantic model → report → dashboard).
takeaways.zh: 标签可以在 Desktop 或服务中套用，并由下游项目继承（语义模型 → 报表 → 仪表板）。

takeaways.en: When data is exported to Excel, PowerPoint or PDF, the label and its protection travel with the file.
takeaways.zh: 数据导出到 Excel、PowerPoint 或 PDF 时，标签及其保护会随文件一起带走。

html.en: Sensitivity labels tell people how sensitive content is and can enforce protection. They are defined by the organisation in Microsoft Purview, then enabled for Power BI by the admin.
html.zh: 敏感度标签告诉大家内容有多敏感，也可以强制执行保护。它们由组织在 Microsoft Purview 中定义，再由管理员为 Power BI 启用。

items.en: Apply a label from the Sensitivity button in Desktop, or in an item's settings / the header in the service.
items.zh: 在 Desktop 中通过敏感度按钮套用标签，或在服务中通过项目设置/标头套用。

items.en: Downstream inheritance: a label on a semantic model flows to new reports and dashboards built on it.
items.zh: 下游继承：语义模型上的标签会传递到基于它建立的新报表和仪表板。

items.en: Export: Excel, PowerPoint and PDF exports keep the label and any encryption, so a "Confidential" file stays protected outside Power BI.
items.zh: 导出：导出的 Excel、PowerPoint 和 PDF 会保留标签和加密，所以「机密」文件离开 Power BI 后仍受保护。

items.en: Admins can set a default label and require mandatory labelling.
items.zh: 管理员可以设定默认标签，并要求强制标记。

items.en: A label does not limit who can open the item inside Power BI — workspace roles, sharing and RLS do that.
items.zh: 标签并不限制谁能在 Power BI 中打开项目——那是工作区角色、分享和 RLS 的工作。

q.en: Data exported from a report to Excel must remain encrypted and marked Confidential outside Power BI. What provides this?
q.zh: 从报表导出到 Excel 的数据，离开 Power BI 后必须保持加密并标示为「机密」。什么能做到？

why.en: RLS controls rows seen, not protection of exported files.
why.zh: RLS 控制可见的行，不保护导出的文件。

html.en: A sensitivity label with protection applied to the report or semantic model
html.zh: 对报表或语义模型套用带保护设置的敏感度标签
